articles.title: tester-army/e2e
articles.excerpt: Next generation e2e testing framework for web and mobile apps.
articles.summary: 面向 Web 与移动应用的下一代端到端（e2e）测试框架，主打用更现代的架构替代传统 e2e 方案，覆盖浏览器与移动端 App 的自动化流程验证。适合需要在 CI 中回归真实用户路径、又不想被旧框架配置复杂度拖累的前端与 QA 团队。

articles.title: pbakaus/impeccable
articles.excerpt: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
articles.summary: 一套面向 AI 编程代理的设计语言，用来提升 AI harness 在界面与视觉设计上的产出质量。它把设计规范与审美约束沉淀成代理可读的规则，让 Claude Code 等工具生成的前端界面不再千篇一律，适合用 AI 写前端又在意设计品质的开发者。

articles.title: coreyhaines31/marketingskills
articles.excerpt: Marketing skills for Claude Code and AI agents. CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.
articles.summary: 为 Claude Code 及各类 AI agent 准备的营销技能包，覆盖 CRO 转化率优化、文案撰写、SEO、数据分析和增长工程。把营销方法论封装成代理可调用的技能，让 AI 直接产出落地页文案、关键词策略与增长实验方案，适合独立开发者和小型增长团队。

articles.title: DietrichGebert/ponytail
articles.excerpt: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
articles.summary: 让 AI 代理像团队里最“懒”的资深工程师那样思考：能不写的代码就不写，优先删减而非堆砌。通过在代理工作流中注入这种极简取向，抑制 AI 常见的过度设计与无关代码生成，适合厌倦 AI 一次产出大段冗余代码的开发者。

articles.title: earthtojake/text-to-cad
articles.excerpt: Give your agent CAD superpowers.
articles.summary: 为 AI 代理赋予 CAD 能力：用自然语言描述即可生成或修改三维 CAD 模型，让代理调用建模工具完成参数化设计。适合硬件工程师与产品设计师把文字需求快速转成可编辑的 3D 模型，缩短从想法到原型验证的时间。

articles.title: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
articles.excerpt: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
articles.summary: 让 AI 代理「长出眼睛」看整个互联网：一个 CLI 即可读取和搜索 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书等平台内容，无需逐个申请 API，零接口费用。适合做舆情监控、竞品调研与信息聚合的开发者。

articles.title: getsentry/sentry
articles.excerpt: Developer-first error tracking and performance monitoring
articles.summary: 面向开发者的错误追踪与性能监控平台，可捕获前后端异常、堆栈、版本与用户上下文，并定位慢事务和性能瓶颈。支持自托管，覆盖 Web、移动端与后端多语言 SDK，是线上服务排障和稳定性建设的常用基础设施。

articles.title: calesthio/OpenMontage
articles.excerpt: World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files. Turn your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio.
articles.summary: 号称首个开源、代理化的视频制作系统，内置 12 条制作流水线、100 多个工具以及 700 多份代理技能与制作知识文件，把 AI 编程助手变成完整的视频生产团队。适合想用自然语言驱动脚本、剪辑到成片流程的内容创作者。

articles.title: pingdotgg/t3code
articles.summary: 来自 pingdotgg 团队（T3 Chat、create-t3-app 作者）的代码相关项目，从仓库信息看与 T3 技术栈的编码工具有关，官方暂未提供描述，具体能力需查看仓库源码与 README 确认。

articles.title: caddyserver/caddy
articles.excerpt: Fast and extensible multi-platform HTTP/1-2-3 web server with automatic HTTPS
articles.summary: 用 Go 编写的快速、可扩展多平台 Web 服务器，原生支持 HTTP/1、HTTP/2 与 HTTP/3，并自动申请和续期 TLS 证书，无需手工配置 HTTPS。配置简洁、插件生态丰富，常用于反向代理、静态站点托管和内网服务暴露。

articles.title: michael-denyer/pstack-claude
articles.excerpt: Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OpenCode, Gemini, and Prime Agent versions of Poteto's pstack. Rigorous agent workflows with Cursor primitives translated for other harnesses.
articles.summary: 把 Poteto 的 pstack 代理工作流移植到 Claude Code、Codex、Pi、OpenCode、Gemini、Prime Agent 等多个 harness，将 Cursor 的原始配置与严格流程翻译成各平台可用版本。适合想在非 Cursor 环境复用成熟、规范化 AI 编码工作流的团队。

articles.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
articles.excerpt: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
articles.summary: 由 Addy Osmani 整理的面向 AI 编码代理的生产级工程技能集，把代码评审、测试、性能优化、架构决策等一线工程规范沉淀为代理可加载的技能，帮助 Claude Code 等工具按团队标准工作，而不是只写「能跑」的代码。

articles.title: thedotmack/claude-mem
articles.excerpt: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
articles.summary: 为各类 AI 代理提供跨会话的持久上下文：记录代理在会话中的全部操作，用 AI 压缩成摘要，并在后续会话中自动注入相关记忆。兼容 Claude Code 等工具，解决每次新对话都要重新交代项目背景的痛点。

articles.title: garrytan/gstack
articles.excerpt: Use Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup: 23 opinionated tools that serve as CEO, Designer, Eng Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, and QA
articles.summary: Garry Tan 公开的 Claude Code 配置集合，包含 23 个有明确取向的工具，分别扮演 CEO、设计师、工程经理、发布经理、文档工程师和 QA 等角色。可整套复用到自己项目中，让 AI 代理按完整团队分工协作，适合想借鉴成熟代理工作流的开发者。

articles.title: OpenCut-app/OpenCut

8 major updates to Cloudflare Observability
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare is launching eight major updates that bring logs, traces, analytics, alerts, dashboards, querying, and telemetry export into one observability platform, with simpler and more predictable pricing.

articles.title: Streamline: custom video pipelines with Cloudflare Stream and Workers
articles.excerpt: Streamline demonstrates how to build long-running, continuous video processing pipelines by pairing Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects with a containerized media engine.

articles.title: Introducing Web Search API via AI Gateway
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare AI Gateway now supports native web search API integration in partnership with Ceramic.ai, Exa, and Linkup. Developers can now inject real-time web context into model inference calls via AI Gateway, REST APIs, or Workers bindings.

articles.title: Introducing Cloudflare Traces: follow requests through our entire platform
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare Traces shows how a request moves through security rules, transformations, cache, routing, Workers, and your origin, then follows it across services running anywhere in your stack.

articles.title: Updates on our pledge to make Cloudflare features accessible to everyone
articles.excerpt: A year after pledging to eliminate two-tier product access, Cloudflare has expanded Logpush, multi-account governance, and higher platform limits to all accounts. Here is an update on our progress, how we dogfood these tools internally, and what is coming next.

articles.title: Announcing Cloudflare OHTTP Gateway – expanding access to Cloudflare’s privacy-preserving infrastructure
articles.excerpt: We’re announcing the closed beta of a self-serve Cloudflare OHTTP Gateway. We’re also renaming our Privacy Gateway to Cloudflare OHTTP Relay to better distinguish the two products.

articles.title: Follow the thread: a new dashboard to investigate account abuse
articles.excerpt: Fraudsters are increasingly using AI to bypass stateless security checks. Cloudflare's new Account Abuse Protection dashboard uses stateful analysis and edge-generated Hashed User IDs to help teams investigate and block account abuse.

articles.title: Protected Quick Tunnels: simple accountless authentication for your next dev project
articles.excerpt: Quick Tunnels now support email authentication. Add --allowed-mail to one cloudflared command, and only the addresses or domains you list can reach your local app. No Cloudflare account required on either side.

articles.title: Building for good: How civil society organizations are automating on Cloudflare
articles.excerpt: Some of the world's leading organizations are building the future of non-profit work with Cloudflare.

articles.title: 2026 Birthday week: network performance update
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare now ranks as the fastest provider across 74% of the top 1,000 global networks. By incorporating background telemetry from Cloudflare Challenge Pages, we have expanded our real-user measurement scale while maintaining user privacy.

articles.title: Introducing Clef: our open-source decision models, and new RL fine-tuning platform
articles.excerpt: We are introducing Clef and Clef-flash, open-source decision models hosted on Workers AI for high-speed classification and agentic workflows. Also launching: a new reinforcement learning platform that allows developers to fine-tune decision models using their own data.

articles.title: One year later: Sovereign AI and the fight for choice
articles.excerpt: AI sovereignty is not a zero-sum game, but many governments now believe it is. Cloudflare's answer: more local open-source models, model-agnostic security tools, and a commitment to giving nations genuine choice.

articles.title: Introducing Workers KV Instant — powered by Quicksilver
articles.excerpt: Workers KV Instant delivers sub-2ms p99 read latencies and 250ms global replication across Cloudflare’s 300+ edge locations. KV Instant eliminates cold-read penalties and uses the familiar Workers KV API.

articles.title: Cloudflare OS: your company’s agent workspace, managed for you
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare OS gives everyone in your organization an agent workspace that knows how your company works and connects to its data and systems. We’re opening the waitlist for fully managed deployments that you’ll be able to launch in a few clicks.

articles.title: Announcing Cloudflare K2: serverless event streams
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare K2 is a serverless event streaming service built directly on top of R2 object storage for high-scale data movement and long-term retention. By decoupling producers and consumers at the edge, K2 enables durable, ordered log streams without the operational overhead of traditional broker clu

articles.title: We want you to build the next Git platform on Cloudflare
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare is hosting a competition to see who will build the next Git platform for an era of AI agents. Artifacts is in open beta, with Workers bindings, data jurisdiction controls, and event subscriptions for repository changes.

articles.title: AI Search is now generally available
articles.excerpt: AI Search is now generally available. It embeds image pixels directly for visual search, runs optical character recognition on scanned PDFs, accepts files up to 10 MiB, and works with any chat model. Here's what's new and how pricing works.

articles.title: Support for modern cryptographic algorithms in Workers
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare Workers is adding opt-in support for post-quantum-resistant algorithms ML-KEM and ML-DSA. You can try it today.

articles.title: Introducing Cloudflare Basin: an open, serverless data platform, now generally available
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare Basin is built on Apache Iceberg and R2 Object Storage. With general availability, developers can ingest, manage, and query large datasets at scale without paying data egress fees.
